text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Prepared to wield her completely unrestrained emotions, Yaeno Muteki heads off to the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals, who have now witnessed her overcome the trials of her past, are eager to see how the new and improved Yaeno Muteki fares in a race.
